THE CHRISTIAN GOD IS WORTHY OF WORSHIP · RANDAL RAUSER
"Christians believe God is a maximally great being"

Rauser opens by stating the Christian maximal-greatness conception, qualifying that not every Christian uses this terminology, then infers maximal worship-worthiness within that conception.

"

THE CHRISTIAN GOD IS NOT WORTHY OF WORSHIP · DAN BARKER
"we do have to start with the face value, even if you then later conclude that it's metaphorical"

Barker rejects rigid literalism while defending ordinary meaning as an initial reading, explicitly allowing poetic, literary, metaphorical, and allegorical reasons to move beyond it.

"
